reserveReview.rationale: The October 7 dashboard SSR exposes complete snapshot 6ac6346c75d8eb627b88b6a1 at 2026-10-07T12:00:44.746Z. Gross FBO assets are $1,006,852.76: nine positive Treasury-bill CUSIPs sum to $356,091.65, two repo positions sum to $600,000 and cash is $50,761.11; the category totals and full positive position roster reconcile exactly. Percentages use the gross inventory, rounded to two decimals. The separately disclosed $38,800.91 due-to-administration deduction yields net trust reserves $968,051.85, matching displayed liabilities, and is not silently assigned to an asset category. Verified means the complete public inventory and arithmetic were independently checked, not that financial assurance was obtained. The dashboard expressly describes all metrics outside issued AT-C 205 reports as supplemental, non-assured and not FRNT's system of record. No signed current financial report was retrieved and the statutory 102% target is not asserted as measured coverage. Latest observed bill maturity is November 24, 48 days after the snapshot, carried separately as an observed-portfolio bound rather than a contractual maximum. Previous one-day/immediate liquidity labels are not renewed: this source proves holdings, not whole-position stressed access or final-cash deadlines. Existing custody review is unchanged.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Non-assured gross FBO fair-market-value inventory; net reserves separately deduct due-to-administration
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Asset classes are itemized; repo counterparties, cash-account counterparties and the allocation of the administration payable across assets are not. Dashboard figures have no independent financial-assurance credit.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The Commission names Fiduciary Trust International as holder-benefit trustee/custodian and Franklin Advisers as portfolio manager. Chapter 3 requires FBO trust accounts separate from liquidity and administration accounts; Chapter 2 limits the special obligation to trust assets. Complete subcustodian agreements, current counterparty allocation, reuse restrictions and custody replacement mechanics were not retrieved, so whole-book institutional custody is not asserted. This is no state full-faith-and-credit or deposit-insurance guarantee.
